_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the JTS3ServerMod egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: JTS3ServerMod
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: JTS3ServerMod is a TeamSpeak 3 bot for idle and AFK moves, welcome messages, bad name checks and more. It connects through ServerQuery; its other settings are in the config folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# JTS3ServerMod: downloads the latest version from stefan1200.de, its
# author's site. Your settings (config), plugins and logs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

# Only the latest version is published.
site=https://www.stefan1200.de
loc=$(curl -sSI -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$site/dlrequest.php?file=jts3servermod&type=.zip") || fail "stefan1200.de can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
file="${loc##*/}"
case "$file" in JTS3ServerMod_*.zip) ;; *) fail "stefan1200.de didn't say which version is the latest. Reinstall to try again." ;; esac
version="${file#JTS3ServerMod_}"; version="${version%.zip}"

if [ -f JTS3ServerMod.jar ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "JTS3ServerMod $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading JTS3ServerMod $version"
    curl -fsSL -o $work/jts3.zip "$site/downloads/$file" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q $work/jts3.zip -d $work/jts3
    mv $work/jts3/JTS3ServerMod .raptor-new
    rm -rf $work/jts3 $work/jts3.zip .raptor-new/*.exe .raptor-new/jts3servermod_startscript.sh .raptor-new/tools
    fresh=0
    [ -f config/server1/JTS3ServerMod_server.cfg ] || fresh=1
    put_release .raptor-new config plugins
    # A new bot keeps trying to reach the TeamSpeak server instead of
    # stopping when it's down.
    if [ "$fresh" = 1 ]; then sed -i 's/^bot_connect_forever = 0/bot_connect_forever = 1/' config/server1/JTS3ServerMod_server.cfg; fi
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed JTS3ServerMod $version."

variables.name: TeamSpeak address
variables.description: The address of the TeamSpeak 3 server the bot joins.

variables.name: Voice port
variables.description: The voice port of the virtual server to join.
